# Frame-keyed pad script that drives the determinism harness into an ACTUAL
# MATCH, which is the workload every perf A/B in this project has lacked: the
# old boot-menu.txt run carries ~0.1% of a session's paired-single traffic, so
# an instruction-count comparison there measures a workload that does not
# contain the thing being optimised.
#
# Route (frames from scouting, work/pipe-input/scout-frames.sh):
#   300-2400  START mash   logos, the intro movie, the title screen
#   2251      MODE SELECT, Arcade already highlighted
#   2600-4400 spaced A     Arcade -> character select (Talim) -> stage intro
#   ~4500     BATTLE 1, Talim vs Manghua on the bridge stage
#   4500+     a fixed attack/step pattern so the fight keeps going; an idle
#             player just loses and parks on a continue prompt.
#
# START is deliberately absent after 2400: in a match it opens the pause menu,
# which stops the emulation being a benchmark of anything.
# frame  buttons   stick_x stick_y
